posts.title: LIVING LEGENDS: Margaret Batiuchok
posts.description: LAURA GLAESS and myself just released the first of several interviews for the Living Legends project. The LIVING LEGENDS project was conceived by Laura Glaess and Bobby White to interview New York Lindy Hoppers of different dancing generations.
